mother_scope: Historical semantic retype/repair of the R033-R041 geometry/readout lineage after the native-semantics gate, with theorem-level recomputation restricted to claims that actually depended on invalid N0 promotion.
selective_recompute_criteria: Recompute only if impact is RECOMPUTE_UNDER_N0 or UNRESOLVED_NEEDS_NEW_TASK and the claim is a theorem claim rather than a metadata/taskbook item.

Do not recompute R033 shortest-path formulas, R034 propagation moments/spectra, R037 replication numerics, R039 collapse witnesses, or R041 horizon-carrier mathematics solely because they are N1/N2/N3; retype them.
Preserve exact conditional/readout theorems even when the stronger native interpretation is retracted.
For R038, separate the valid rooted graph-zeta theorem from the invalid metric-free H7 kill; rebuild any native pi/nonexistence claim using only declared N0 relations or return it OPEN.

r043_handling.required_before_r043_continuation: Driver re-review/restamp against the current policy digest.
taskbook_delta: Type contact+occupancy and unweighted relational frontier as N0/N0-definable.
Type S/weights/graph summaries as N2 readout components.
Type chosen addition/action/B_h/all-horizon Markov language as N1 operational semantics.
Do not convert a positive G0/M_h future-carrier theorem into an N0 state-ontology claim.

required_outputs: historical claim ledger with the R044 fields
downstream dependency audit for any Foundation-facing claim that consumed R038-C05/C06
explicit no-recompute ledger for preserved conditional mathematics
stop_condition: R045 returns when every listed claim is either correctly retyped, recomputed under N0, or explicitly OPEN with no stronger native claim remaining unsupported.
